body:
Steps 1–2 of the refactor plan (task:fc9bf315f4eddc7a, notes 6 and 12): the baseline gate, then shared helpers. Public CLI behavior stays unchanged.

1. **Baseline gate.** Rerun `check --warnings`, `rust-unit`, `rust-acceptance` and `spacing_parity` (the recorded results are stale). If one fails, fix it or quarantine it before going on.
2. **Shared helpers.** Add `fsx`, `jsonx` and `project_paths`, move the helpers into them with `extract`, update every caller, and remove an old wrapper only once `refs` shows nothing calls it.
   - `crate.write_atomic` vs `tasks.replace_file`/`tasks.replace_bytes`, and `crate.lock_file` vs `board.lock`, are **not** duplicates (D-207). Unifying them means picking one behavior and moving callers to it, and each caller must keep its current durability (sync-to-disk) and locking guarantees. Use `merge` only where signatures already match.
   - The plan found no compiler-visible dead code. Delete only what this step replaces.

New tests go into `<module>_tests.rs` files (D-206). After each change, run `check --warnings`, `rust-unit` and the affected acceptance suite.
title: Cleanup: baseline and shared helpers
